summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LivePaste NEW FEATURES: image support (upload, display, real-time sync, delete) and line numbers + status bar. All backend image APIs (24/24 tests) and frontend features tested successfully. Minor UI feedback timing issue noted but functionality is 100% working.

design_issues.issue: Button text reverts from 'Copied' to 'Copy link' very quickly (< 1 second), making it hard to see the feedback. However, toast notification works correctly showing 'Link copied to clipboard'

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/paste/{slug}/image with valid PNG returns 200 with {id, url, name, size, contentType}
Backend: GET /api/image/{id} streams image with correct content-type and byte size
Backend: POST image with non-image content-type (text/plain) returns 400
Backend: POST image to non-existent slug returns 404
Backend: DELETE /api/image/{id} returns 200, subsequent GET returns 404
Backend: GET /api/image/{invalid-id} returns 404
Frontend: Click 'Add image' button, use set_input_files on hidden input with PNG - markdown reference ![filename](.../api/image/...) appears in editor
Frontend: Attachments strip (data-testid=paste-attachments-strip) appears with thumbnail image that loads (naturalWidth > 0)
Frontend: Toast shows 'Image added' after upload
Frontend REAL-TIME: Image uploaded in tab 1 appears in tab 2 (both inline reference AND attachments strip) within ~2 seconds
Frontend: Delete image via trash button (data-testid=paste-attachment-delete-{id}) - reference removed from editor, strip disappears, GET /api/image/{id} returns 404
Frontend: Line numbers gutter (data-testid=paste-line-numbers) shows numbers matching line count
Frontend: Typing new lines in editor increases gutter count live (tested 3 → 5 lines)
Frontend: Status bar (data-testid=paste-status-line-count) shows correct 'N lines · M chars · size' format
Frontend: Status bar updates live as you type (verified 3 lines → 5 lines → 6 lines)
Frontend: Copy URL button in attachments strip (data-testid=paste-attachment-copy-{id}) shows 'Image URL copied' toast
Regression: Create paste from home page works
Regression: Real-time text sync between 2 tabs works (250ms debounce + WS broadcast)
Regression: Copy link button works (toast appears)
Regression: Dark mode toggle works (adds/removes 'dark' class)
Existing paste /glo9RKR with image still works correctly (image loads, attachments strip displays)

success_percentage.backend: 100% (24/24 tests passed - includes 7 new image API tests)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all new image features + line numbers + status bar + regression tests passed)
